item.title: CVE-2026-126759 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A flaw has been found in H3C ICG2000 Unified Communication Gateway 2023. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /wnm/check.j of the component Web Management Module. Executing a manipulation can lead to missing authentication. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. The researcher claims that the vendor has acknowledged receipt of the vulnerability report. No further response has been received.

item.title: CVE-2026-126932 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Zipline 4.6.2 before 4.8.0 contains a policy bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade administrator-disabled MIME types by editing file metadata. Attackers can upload a permitted file, then set a disabled type such as text/html through PATCH /api/user/files/:id so /raw/:id serves that Content-Type.

item.title: CVE-2026-126933 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Zipline 4.0.0 before 4.8.0 contains an upload filter bypass vulnerability that allows users with upload access to store blocked file types due to extension format mismatch. The upload and partial handlers compare dotted, case-sensitive extensions against undotted disabledExtensions entries, letting authenticated or permitted unauthenticated folder uploaders bypass administrator restrictions.

item.title: CVE-2026-126934 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Zipline 4.3.2 before 4.8.0 contains a rate limit bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade throttling by spoofing X-Forwarded-For headers when core.trustProxy is enabled. Attackers can send a different X-Forwarded-For value per request to obtain fresh rate-limit buckets, enabling unlimited guessing of login passwords, TOTP codes, and file and URL passwords.

item.title: CVE-2026-126935 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Zipline before 4.8.0 contains a race condition vulnerability in src/server/routes/raw/[id].ts that allows remote attackers to bypass file maxViews limits through non-atomic view counting. Attackers holding a file link can send parallel requests that read the same pre-increment count, viewing view-limited or delete-on-max-views files beyond their limit.

item.title: CVE-2026-68549 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 3.3
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 3.3 | ClickMigrate is a database migration tool for ClickHouse with automatic SQL migration management and version tracking. Prior to version 1.0.3, a path traversal vulnerability in the revision command allowed a crafted migration name supplied via the -m argument to escape the intended migrations directory. Under specific conditions, an attacker could cause the tool to create a .sql file in an arbitrary location writable by the user executing the command. This issue is only exploitable if an attacker can influence the migration name passed to the revision command, such as through an insecure automation or CI/CD pipeline that forwards untrusted input. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.3.
